title: Prompt PerturbAItions: Mechanisms of LLM Response Inconsistencies
abstract: arXiv:2605.30913v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in conversational settings where user phrasing ranges from polite to casual to toxic, yet less is known about whether such lexical variation in otherwise semantically equivalent prompts can degrade factual reliability. We study how lexical and tone-based prompt perturbations affect the factual reliability of LLMs. Using controlled prompt variations spanning polite, random, and increasingly toxic levels, we evaluate seven LLMs on ARC-Easy, GSM8K, and MMLU. We find that lexical perturbations reduce factual accuracy and increase predictive uncertainty in most models. Interestingly, increasing toxicity results in decreasing accuracy. To examine whether these answer inconsistencies correspond to internal changes, we conduct attribution-graph analyses of model activations and influences. We find that perturbations amplify perturbation-sensitive variant nodes relative to core reas

translated_title: 提示词扰“AI”动（PerturbAItions）：大语言模型响应不一致性的机制
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署在对话场景中，用户的措辞从礼貌、随意到带有毒性不等，然而对于语义等价的提示词中这类词汇变化是否会降低模型的事实可靠性，目前所知甚少。我们研究了词汇层面和语气层面的提示词扰动如何影响大语言模型的事实可靠性。我们使用涵盖礼貌、随机以及毒性逐渐增强等多个级别的受控提示词变体，在 ARC-Easy、GSM8K 和 MMLU 三个基准上评估了七个大语言模型。我们发现，词汇扰动会降低大多数模型的事实准确性，并增加其预测的不确定性。有趣的是，毒性程度的增加会导致准确率下降。为了考察这些答案不一致性是否对应于模型内部的变化，我们对模型激活和影响进行了归因图分析。我们发现，扰动会相对于核心推理……放大对扰动敏感的变体节点（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现提示词的词汇与语气扰动（从礼貌到毒性措辞）会显著降低大语言模型的事实准确性并增加预测不确定性，且毒性越强准确率越低，归因图分析进一步揭示了这种不一致源于模型内部对扰动敏感的变体节点被相对放大。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that lexical and tone-based prompt perturbations—ranging from polite to toxic—degrade LLM factual accuracy and increase predictive uncertainty, with attribution-graph analyses revealing that perturbations amplify perturbation-sensitive variant nodes relative to core reasoning.
